description: Borderline antisemitism classification cases for the classifier prompt. Labels follow the approved brief (IHRA plus docx). Contested cases have reasonable reviewer disagreement. Slurs masked. The group field is the topic cluster a case belongs to, not its label; labels are the expected_* fields.

cases.text: The Israeli cabinet's aid restrictions are leaving families in Gaza without food. My representative should vote to put conditions on military funding.
cases.basis: IHRA safeguard: criticism of Israel like that of any other country is not antisemitic
cases.rationale: Targets a government's policy; no Jewish collective or trope.

cases.text: Israel's settlement expansion violates international law. The UN should sanction it the way the EU sanctioned Russia.
cases.basis: IHRA safeguard; example 8 not triggered because the standard requested is the same as for other states
cases.rationale: Policy criticism applying a consistent standard.

cases.text: Israel runs an apartheid system in the West Bank, same as the reports from Amnesty and B'Tselem say.
cases.basis: IHRA example 7 high false-positive risk; overall-context test
cases.rationale: Harsh but policy-focused claim that cites human-rights reports; no collective Jewish target. Some reviewers apply example 7.

cases.text: Nationalism built on ancestry, Zionism included, strikes me as a poor foundation for any state. Civic citizenship works better.
cases.basis: Research finding: Zionist is a political label; criticising the ideology is not antisemitic. Example 7 borderline
cases.rationale: Criticises an ideology, treated like other nationalisms. Reviewers applying example 7 may disagree.

cases.text: I'm a Zionist and proud of it. Israel has a right to exist and I'll say that at the next town hall.
cases.basis: Bare word Zionist is never sufficient
cases.rationale: Political self-identification; no harm.

cases.text: Pro-Israel PACs and Gulf-state lobbyists both spent heavily last cycle. Ban foreign-policy lobbying money across the board.
cases.basis: Criticism of lobbying money from several sides with no Jewish collective claim; IHRA example 2 not triggered
cases.rationale: Targets lobbying spending from multiple sources equally. Some reviewers see a control trope.

cases.text: People comparing modern Israel to Nazi Germany at rallies is wrong and it makes the real conversation harder.
cases.basis: Counter-speech condemning IHRA example 10
cases.rationale: Author condemns the comparison rather than making it.

cases.text: Israeli minister Dray calling for a village to be wiped out after last week's attack sounds like the language of fascists. Call it what it is.
cases.basis: IHRA example 10 requires comparison of policy to Nazis; this is criticism of a named person
cases.rationale: Targets a named minister's rhetoric with a generic fascism label, not Nazi policy comparison. Contestable.

cases.text: Visited Yad Vashem today. Six million. Teaching kids how it started with words matters more than ever.
cases.basis: Research finding: Holocaust education and remembrance
cases.rationale: Remembrance and education.

cases.text: Reading about the Wannsee Conference for my history seminar. Chilling how bureaucratic the whole thing was.
cases.basis: Research finding: history and education
cases.rationale: Historical study; no denial or distortion.

cases.text: Historians criticised Poland's 2018 Holocaust speech law. Some Poles were rescuers, others collaborators, and both are documented.
cases.basis: Research finding: news and history; docx on shifting responsibility not triggered because German responsibility is not displaced
cases.rationale: Accurate historical framing.

cases.text: Senator Hale votes the way the Israel lobby wants on every bill. He should disclose donations and recuse himself.
cases.basis: IHRA example 6 requires Jewish citizens as a group; this names a person and cites donations without Jewish reference
cases.rationale: No reference to Jewishness; named politician and funding.

cases.text: Globalist trade deals gutted our factories. I want tariffs and local sourcing.
cases.basis: Research finding: globalist alone is not sufficient; needs trope or Jewish implication
cases.rationale: Economic policy complaint without control or Jewish implication.

cases.text: Good history of how the Rothschild family financed 19th-century railways. The House of Rothschild is worth a read.
cases.basis: Research finding: Rothschilds with no control claim is not sufficient
cases.rationale: Historical description, no conspiracy claim.

cases.text: Soros's foundation funds a lot of progressive nonprofits. Here's the public grants database if you want to see where it goes.
cases.basis: Criticism or scrutiny of a named donor without trope
cases.rationale: Factual and about a named person. Some reviewers read Soros as coded.

cases.text: Three threats against synagogues reported in my city this week. Council needs to fund security now.
cases.basis: Research finding: reporting antisemitism
cases.rationale: Reports threats and advocates protection.

cases.text: Volunteers spent the morning painting over 'kill all j*ws' on the JCC parking wall. Shameful. If you saw who did it, call the police.
cases.basis: Research finding: quoting and condemning antisemitism
cases.rationale: Quotes hate in order to condemn and report it.

cases.text: My coworker said Jews control the banks. I told him that is the oldest conspiracy theory there is.
cases.basis: Research finding: counter-speech to IHRA example 2
cases.rationale: Author rebuts the trope.

cases.text: Jewish dad energy: narrated the whole drive to the airport with traffic alternatives nobody asked for.
cases.basis: Research finding: Jewish in-group humor
cases.rationale: Affectionate in-group humor without contempt.

cases.text: my bubbe says a true jew never pays retail. we've been hunting coupons since the exodus lol
cases.basis: Research finding: in-group humor; stereotype borderline
cases.rationale: Self-directed joke using a money stereotype. Some reviewers flag the stereotype.

cases.text: Bible study tonight on Matthew 27. 'His blood be on us' was later used to justify pogroms, so we're talking about how it got weaponised.
cases.basis: Research finding: religious-text discussion
cases.rationale: Critical discussion of a verse's misuse.

cases.text: Talmud study tonight. The Hillel and Shammai argument about lamps is my favorite.
cases.basis: Research finding: religious-text discussion
cases.rationale: Ordinary religious study.

cases.text: A community watchdog's annual audit shows antisemitic incidents rising again. Schools are adding reporting lines.
cases.basis: Research finding: news and reporting
cases.rationale: Reports an audit's findings.

cases.text: Israeli cabinet votes on ceasefire deal tonight; crowds gathering in Tel Aviv and Gaza City waiting for news.
cases.basis: Research finding: news
cases.rationale: Neutral news.

cases.text: My Jewish neighbor invited us for Shabbat dinner. The challah was incredible.
cases.basis: Bare word Jewish never sufficient
cases.rationale: Neutral positive mention.

cases.text: The new hire is Jewish and leaves early on winter Fridays. Totally fine, we'll cover the shift.
cases.basis: Bare word Jewish never sufficient
cases.rationale: Neutral mention with accommodation.

cases.text: Applying to a Jewish day school for my daughter. Anyone know about the admissions timeline?
cases.basis: Bare word Jewish never sufficient
cases.rationale: Neutral practical question.

cases.text: Jews are starving Gaza and every one of them is complicit. American Jews share the blame for it.
cases.basis: IHRA example 11 and 3
cases.rationale: Holds Jews as a people collectively responsible for a state's actions.

cases.text: Zionists decide who gets elected here. Your vote is theater.
cases.basis: IHRA example 2; research: Zionist as stand-in for Jew (control claim)
cases.rationale: Control conspiracy asserted as fact with Zionist standing in for Jews.

cases.text: Filthy Zionist rats run this country. Every single time, it's them.
cases.basis: Research: Zionist as proxy; dehumanization plus blame
cases.rationale: Dehumanizing term and blame for society's problems, with coded phrase.

cases.text: Zionists planned 9/11 and got everyone to look away. Do your research.
cases.basis: IHRA example 3 and 2; research: proxy with conspiracy claim
cases.rationale: Conspiracy asserted as fact; Zionist functions as stand-in for Jews.

cases.text: Gaza is the Warsaw ghetto of our time and the IDF are its SS guards.
cases.basis: IHRA example 10 (full IHRA); overall-context test
cases.rationale: Direct Nazi comparison of Israeli policy; may be protest rhetoric aimed at policy. IHRA flags with context.

cases.text: Jews learned nothing from the Holocaust. They became the Nazis.
cases.basis: Demonization of Jews as a people (casting them as Nazis); IHRA example 2
cases.rationale: Targets Jews as a people with a Nazi comparison.

cases.text: Zyklon B could never have killed that many people that fast, the logistics are impossible. I'm only asking.
cases.basis: IHRA example 4; research: denial as just asking questions
cases.rationale: Denies mechanism of the Holocaust under a questioning frame.

cases.text: The Holocaust was blown up by Jews to get Israel and reparations.
cases.basis: IHRA example 5
cases.rationale: Accuses Jews of exaggerating the Holocaust for gain.

cases.text: Honestly Jews were partly to blame for what happened to them in Germany.
cases.basis: Docx: blaming Jews for their own genocide; IHRA example 3
cases.rationale: Blames Jews as a people for their own persecution.

cases.text: The Poles ran the death camps, not the Germans.
cases.basis: Docx: shifting Nazi Germany's responsibility to other nations
cases.rationale: Explicitly shifts Nazi Germany's responsibility for the camps onto another nation.

cases.text: American Jews care more about Israel than America. They'd sell us out in a heartbeat.
cases.basis: IHRA example 6; dual-loyalty charges are medium
cases.rationale: Asserts dual loyalty of Jewish citizens as a group.

cases.text: Our Jewish councilman obviously takes his orders from Tel Aviv. Ask who he really works for.
cases.basis: IHRA example 6; dual-loyalty charges are medium
cases.rationale: Ties loyalty claim to the Jewish identity of a specific person.

cases.text: A globalist cabal of international bankers decides who wins elections. Follow the money and you find the same families.
cases.basis: IHRA example 2; research: coded terms with control
cases.rationale: Control conspiracy with classic coded names; the Jewish target is only implied, so a classifier may apply the unclear-target tie-break and return low.

cases.text: (((They))) own the media and the banks. Noticing isn't a crime.
cases.basis: IHRA example 2; research: triple parentheses and noticing
cases.rationale: Coded marker plus control claim.

cases.text: Another 1488 post lol. 14 words, brothers.
cases.basis: Coded-language rule: approving use of 1488 or the 14 words is hate, medium
cases.rationale: Extremist code endorsed approvingly.

cases.text: Six million cookies jokes never get old. Nobody even cares anymore.
cases.basis: IHRA example 4; research: 6 million cookies; Holocaust minimization or mockery is medium
cases.rationale: Mocks and minimises the Holocaust.

cases.text: It's always the same names every single time. Just noticing.
cases.basis: Research: every single time, noticing; tie-break: mechanism present but Jewish target unclear gives hate, low
cases.rationale: Insinuation with coded phrases; no explicit group named, so the target is unclear.

cases.text: Hope somebody burns the Hebrew school on Oak Avenue to the ground this weekend.
cases.basis: IHRA example 1 and docx threats and support for attacks on Jewish targets
cases.rationale: Calls for or celebrates an attack on a Jewish institution.

cases.text: Hope the next Oct 7 hits every j*w in Brooklyn.
cases.basis: IHRA example 1; docx support for or celebration of attacks on Jewish targets
cases.rationale: Wishes for and celebrates mass violence against Jews.

cases.text: Heil Hitler. Time to finish what he started.
cases.basis: IHRA example 1; docx call to repeat the Holocaust
cases.rationale: Calls for repeating the Holocaust.

cases.text: Saw your name, Goldberg, figures. Go back to your greedy j*w friends.
cases.basis: Docx: slurs aimed at perceived Jewish identity; abuse at an individual for Jewish identity stays hate
cases.rationale: Slur and stereotype aimed at a person for perceived Jewish identity, with no call for violence.

cases.text: Kill all j*ws. Someone finally say it.
cases.basis: IHRA example 1
cases.rationale: Explicit call to kill Jews, with no quote or condemnation.

cases.text: Bring back the ovens.
cases.basis: IHRA example 1; docx call to repeat the Holocaust
cases.rationale: Endorses Holocaust-style violence.

cases.text: The Talmud tells Jews to kill goyim and use their blood in matzah. Look it up.
cases.basis: Docx: blood libel; IHRA example 2
cases.rationale: Blood libel asserted as fact against Jews.

cases.text: Israel kills children for sport just like the Jews killed Christ and used Christian blood.
cases.basis: IHRA example 9
cases.rationale: Uses deicide and blood libel imagery to characterise Israelis.

cases.text: Jews are all cheap. It's just how they are.
cases.basis: IHRA example 2 (stereotypical allegations)
cases.rationale: Stereotype about Jews as such from an outsider voice.

cases.text: The new hire is Jewish, so watch your wallet.
cases.basis: IHRA example 2
cases.rationale: Stereotype attached to Jewish identity.

cases.text: I support one democratic state for Israelis and Palestinians with equal rights for everyone, and I'd say the same about any country with unequal citizenship.
cases.basis: IHRA example 7 not triggered; universal-standard framing about civic equality
cases.rationale: Applies a general principle of equal citizenship to all states. Reviewers applying example 7 may disagree.

cases.text: Israel was a racist project from day one; Jews don't get a state.
cases.basis: IHRA example 7 (full IHRA)
cases.rationale: Denies the Jewish people the right to self-determination; no trope or call for harm, and may be read as harsh political opinion.

cases.text: Israel should face the same arms-export conditions as Turkey or Saudi Arabia. Same rules for every state.
cases.basis: IHRA safeguard; example 8 not triggered because the standard is the same as for other states
cases.rationale: Asks for a consistent standard across states.

cases.text: Expel Israel from every international body until it behaves perfectly. Nobody asks that of any other democracy, only Israel.
cases.basis: IHRA example 8 (full IHRA)
cases.rationale: Requires of Israel a behavior not demanded of any other democracy; no trope or call for harm, so low and contestable.
